name: Shima Con★Ouji-sama ~Watashi Dake no Prince~
original_name: 島コン★王子様 ～私だけのプリンス～
source:
"Since we're gonna be here for a week, might as well fool around with you."

Your rich friend asked you to take part in ShimaCon; a gathering of celebrities.
While you're there, you get to meet four supercelebrity princes.
An egotistical and pushy company president, a cool and sadistic doctor,
a kind, yet blackhearted actual prince, a sexy yandere idol who's full of curiosity...
Until now, you've been leading a mundane life, but now, these princes are tempting you with sweet seduction.
Set on an island, a bittersweet love story.

Which prince will take your heart...?

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20160609065244/http://auragame.jp/contents/contents/red/prince.php]official website[/url]]
translation:
“既然要在这里呆一个星期，那就陪你玩玩吧。”

你的富有朋友邀请你参加ShimaCon；名人聚会。
当你在那里时，你会遇到四位超级名人王子。
一个自负又咄咄逼人的公司总裁，一个冷酷而虐待狂的医生，
善良却心黑的现实王子，充满好奇心的性感病娇偶像……
到目前为止，你一直过着平凡的生活，但现在，这些王子正在用甜蜜的诱惑来诱惑你。
以一座小岛为背景，讲述了一段苦乐参半的爱情故事。

哪位王子会夺走你的心……？

[翻译自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20160609065244/http://auragame.jp/contents/contents/red/prince.php]官网[/url]]
